Jasper Wieck, German Ambassador to India and Bhutan in conversation with Narayan Lakshman, Director of The Hindu. | Photo Credit: Johan Sathya Das J.
In a wide-ranging interview, German Ambassador to India Jasper Wieck spoke to The Hindu about evolving European security architecture, the potential for growth in the India-EU Free Trade Agreement (FTA), bilateral clean energy and defence initiatives and opportunities for skilled Indian workers in Germany.
